acceptanceCriteria: A recorded control schema (owner, proving evidence, retirement condition) is defined in DOGFOOD.md or a cited spec.
Each existing dogfood step and AGENTS.md hard rule is listed with those three fields, or explicitly marked as having no retirement condition with a reason.
At least one control whose retirement condition is already met is identified or the audit records that none is.
body: Controls (gates, dogfood steps, AGENTS.md rules) accumulate and none carries a stated condition under which it may be removed; `retire` in docs/specs refers to migrations and code paths, not controls (inferred from file names, confirm when starting). Lessons 46 and 54 of the source require each promoted control to carry one owner, the verification that proves it, and a retirement condition, so the rule set can shrink as well as grow. Source: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch, Phase 14 agent-workbench track, reviewed 2026-09-24.
title: dogfood: give every gate and promoted control an owner, proof, and retirement condition
